bag_wtp_rebuild_zone = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_continents
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_zone_count value = 0 }

	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_ticks }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_ticks
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_zone_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Every land location of the ticked continents, for when the player ranks a whole
# continent without narrowing it first.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_collect_zone = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_continents

			limit = { bag_wtp_is_candidate = yes }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_candidates target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_candidate_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
